channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The weekend’s conversion story is geographic, not silicon. TCS HyperVault locked 264 acres in Hyderabad for an up-to-1 GW AI campus (₹70,000 crore / ~$7.4B with partners; CM target June 2028), while Ohio’s OPSB put AEP’s Baku–Gavin 765 kV (~51 mi, ~$1.1B, developer-paid) on docket 26-0426-EL-BTX with an Oct 27 hearing — the grid permit that PORTS-Pike still needs. Same morning, Korea JoongAng reports Stargate Korea still has no site, power, or funding a year after the Samsung/SK MOU. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm day: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged.

item.title: Compute brief — 7 September 2026
item.description: The weekend’s conversion story is geographic, not silicon. TCS HyperVault locked 264 acres in Hyderabad for an up-to-1 GW AI campus (₹70,000 crore / ~$7.4B with partners; CM target June 2028), while Ohio’s OPSB put AEP’s Baku–Gavin 765 kV (~51 mi, ~$1.1B, developer-paid) on docket 26-0426-EL-BTX with an Oct 27 hearing — the grid permit that PORTS-Pike still needs. Same morning, Korea JoongAng reports Stargate Korea still has no site, power, or funding a year after the Samsung/SK MOU. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm day: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged. Countries: India / Telangana: TCS HyperVault (5 Sep): 264 acres Hyderabad, up to 1 GW, ≤₹70,000 crore with partners; June 2028 inauguration ask from CM. PPA/EPC/offtake still unpublished. United States / Ohio: OPSB case 26-0426-EL-BTX (Baku–Gavin 765 kV for PORTS-Pike) live; local hearing 27 Oct. Howard–Solstice 59336 still HOLD. South Korea: Samsung SDS / SKT / OpenAI all say Stargate Korea campus path still unset (power, water, site, funding) — Stall beside the live AIDC budget track.
